2026-07-21.content:
Cloud Tasks support for the following is available in
[Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products#product-launch-stages):

* [Set retry parameters when creating a task](https://docs.cloud.google.com/tasks/docs/configure-retry-task)
  and override the queue-level retry configuration for the task.
* [Create a batch of tasks](https://docs.cloud.google.com/tasks/docs/create-tasks#create-batch-tasks)
  and add the batch to an existing queue.
* [Delete a batch of tasks](https://docs.cloud.google.com/tasks/docs/manage-queues-and-tasks#delete-batch-tasks)
  from a queue.

summary.title: Cloud Tasks adds new features
summary.summary: Cloud Tasks now supports setting retry parameters when creating a task, creating a batch of tasks, and deleting a batch of tasks. These features are available in preview.

2026-07-14.content:
Cloud Tasks is available in the following [locations](https://docs.cloud.google.com/tasks/docs/locations):

* `me-central1` (Doha, Qatar)
* `me-central2` (Dammam, Saudi Arabia)

summary.title: Cloud Tasks now in Middle East
summary.summary: Cloud Tasks is now available in two new Middle East locations: me-central1 (Doha, Qatar) and me-central2 (Dammam, Saudi Arabia). This expansion offers greater choice and proximity for users in the region.
